roads.name: West Ham Lane
roads.alignmentEvidence: Street or lane centreline checked against the same source map as the housing envelopes. Corrects the previous independently approximated road layer. Name corrected October 2026 (was "Warton Road"): OS London five-foot 1893–96 mosaic (NLS os-london-five-foot-1893, zoom 18), crops centred on scene (260,-830) and (320,-680), prints "WEST HAM LANE" along this street at about (248,-868) and (365,-640); the EPFL OS text layer has "HAM" (235,-889), "LANE" (258,-859), "WEST" (352,-692) and "LANE" (386,-614). No WARTON label is printed on this street; WARTON ROAD is printed at (-744,-758)/(-688,-677), on Warton Road northern section. Estimated: the traced centreline lies about 5–50 m west of the printed carriageway (traced at the VIII.22 sheet edge; the lane straddles the VIII.23 join) and south of Paul Street runs over the Arthingworth Street east frontage; geometry not corrected.
